title: Sweep LR warmdown length (WARMDOWN_RATIO 0.5 -> 0.8)
description: Increased WARMDOWN_RATIO from 0.5 to 0.8 (longer, gentler linear cooldown starting at progress=0.2 instead of 0.5), all else unchanged from DEPTH=10 baseline.
reflection: val_bpb 1.004858, worse than the 1.002279 baseline (a ~0.25% regression). A longer cooldown phase apparently costs more than it helps within this fixed 5-minute budget — spending less time at the flat/peak LR seems to hurt more than the smoother decay helps. This pins down the LR-schedule-shape axis as another dead end after depth and Muon-LR-magnitude; future rounds should probably try a shorter warmdown (e.g. 0.3) if this axis is revisited, or move to an entirely different lever (weight decay, embedding LR, window pattern) rather than more schedule-shape tweaks.
